title: Cardiorespiratory Emergence: Heart and Lung as Coupled Relaxation Oscillators under Reflex Control
abstract: Heart and lung emerge from measured master-gene stacking stabilities as one relaxation oscillator; from a single resting-heart-rate time anchor the model derives eupnea, the apnea threshold, respiratory sinus arrhythmia, the Cheyne-Stokes period, baroreflex regulation, and a shared R19 carcinogen dose-response kernel with forced no-threshold relative risk.
